text: of perfect beauty: Heb. perfect of beauty
oars...have made thy benches of Ivory: Or, they have made thy hatches of ivory well trodden | the company: Heb. the daughter
blue and purple: Or, purple and scarlet
calkers: Or, stoppers of chinks. Heb. strengtheners
wares: Heb. works | Agate: Or, Chrysoprase
going to and fro: Or, Meuzall
precious clothes: Heb. clothes of freedom
they occupied with thee: Heb. they were the merchants of thy hand
sorts of things: Or, excellent things | clothes: Heb. followings
and in: Or, even withall | middest: Or, heart
a terror: Heb. terrors | never shalt be any more: Heb. shalt not be forever
